Hero.description: I turn your ideas into thoughtful websites and digital experiences that help your brand grow.

About.title: Hi, I'm Tetiana
About.subtitle: Your design partner
About.paragraph1: I'm an independent digital designer working at the intersection of strategy, identity, and the web. I help businesses turn their ideas into clear, functional, and visually distinctive digital experiences.
About.paragraph2: My approach is simple: listen closely, explore different visual styles, pay attention to details, and make every design decision count.
About.paragraph3: You work directly with me — from the first conversation to the final design handover.

Services.title: Big ideas.
Services.description: From a first impression to a complete experience. Clear scope, close collaboration, considered results.
Services.note: Starting packages for this sample portfolio. Final scope and prices are agreed before we begin.

items.title: Launch your website
items.description: A focused landing page that turns interest into action.

items.title: Build your digital home
items.description: A cohesive website that gives your brand room to grow.

items.title: Make good, better
items.description: A purposeful redesign that removes friction and brings clarity.

steps.title: Discover
steps.text: Every great project starts with a conversation. We discuss your business, goals, audience, ideas, and expectations to understand what your website really needs.

steps.title: Define
steps.text: I explore references, analyze competitors, and define the website's structure and key user flows. This gives us a clear direction before moving into visual design.

steps.title: Wireframe
steps.text: I turn the approved structure into wireframes, arranging content and defining how users will navigate through the website.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: This is where the ideas come to life. I develop the visual style, work with typography, colors, imagery, and details to create a cohesive design that reflects your brand.

steps.title: Finalize
steps.text: We review the design, make the agreed adjustments, and prepare the final Figma files for development. Your design is ready for the next step.

items.question: How much does a project cost?
items.answer: Landing pages start from $500, multi-page websites from $3,500. Final scope and price are agreed before we begin.

items.question: How long does it take?
items.answer: A landing page usually takes 2-3 weeks, a full website 1-2 months.

items.question: How many revisions are included?
items.answer: Two rounds of revisions are included in every package.

items.question: Do you also develop the website?
items.answer: I focus on design and prepare developer-ready Figma files for handover.

items.question: How will we communicate?
items.answer: Via email, Telegram or video calls — whatever is most comfortable for you.
